name: Lagos Life work-scene kit
front: +Z (Blender -Y); nodes sit at the origin, ground at y=0
compression: EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization: GLTFLoader needs setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder). Quantization stores a dequantize transform on each node, so clone a node and put it inside your own Group before positioning it (never overwrite the node's own position/scale).
vertex_colors: COLOR_0 holds baked AO + grime; keep vertexColors on.
emissive: emit_cool (barber LED strip, office/bank tube lights) and emit_warm; 'screen' material uses the atlas as emissive map.

animations.skeleton: Microsoft Rocketbox Bip01 (identical to the game's player_male/player_female node names and rest pose)
